message: September 10th, late at night.
In today's observations, the Hourly Rate ― the number of meteors per hour ― finally reached 180+.
This is a figure far exceeding the peak of any well-known meteor shower.
In this town, famous for its frequent shooting stars, it is not particularly unusual.
Once again, Re-Crea must be drawing near.
Breaking twenty-five years of silence, it seems to have finally begun to move.
Even in past instances of Re-Crea, there has never been such a long cycle.
The significance of this twenty-five-year duration.
Past records indicate that its impact is proportional to the duration of its cycle.
And the volume of shooting stars.
Day by day, it increases without stopping.
Events are unfolding in a way never spoken of in my lifetime, nor in any records.
Measures to handle the situation have been taken ever since we noticed the vicious cycle twelve years ago.
However, Re-Crea is not something visible to the eye.
It is impossible to predict what will specifically happen.
So far, the only thing that ever happened was that people took advantage of the chaos to disrupt public order.
Preventing secondary disasters -- that is what we have done to preserve our world.
Surely, this time should be no different.
If we handle those properly and Re-Crea passes, we will return to our usual daily lives once more.
Yes, if only it were just the usual Re-Crea.
The shooting stars, the bad feeling in my chest, and the backing of records handed down for generations refuse to allow that thought.
In all probability...
The largest Re-Crea in history is drawing near.
Without a doubt.
With every passing moment.
Without having found a single clue toward a solution.
「Even if I'm powerless, I will never give up.」
「Just what is it that inspires you to such an extent?」
「Believing... I suppose.」
「Believing...?」
「In that reliable, elusive, fearless daredevil said to appear during Re―Crea―」
「Ah... do you still believe in that story?\S10」
「Yes! Because we have--」
「Because we have the Demon King!!」
